request: Придумать собственных простых, хорошо читаемых персонажей с индивидуальностью в стиле тайлов.

input_roles.role: environment edit target and tile style/scale reference; existing characters to replace

variants.title: Походный отряд
variants.direction: The balanced baseline. Practical travel clothing and rustic gear. Broad simple shapes and moderate head size, about 2.7 heads tall. Strong clean negative spaces between equipment and body. Warm and understated personalities. Quiet poses with a clear weight shift. Approximately the same amount of visual information in a character as in three adjacent tiles. Stepped pixel edges at roughly the scale visible in the tile seams.
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: original tactical game character art direction preview on the supplied tile board, 1536x1024 landscape.
Input image 1: edit target for the ENVIRONMENT, camera, tile scale, lighting and color style only. Replace ALL six old characters completely with six newly designed original characters. Do not reuse the old character designs.
Keep the floating diamond island, tile grid, branching river, grass, sand, rock, shoreline, small plants and dark plum background in the same positions and visual style as the reference. No cropping, no zoom, no text, no UI, no montage.
Create exactly six SMALL characters, roughly 85–110 pixels tall each in this 1536x1024 image, occupying their own single tiles. They must look drawn by the SAME artist and with the SAME simplified crisp raster technique as the terrain. Compact connected pixel clusters, visibly stepped contours, two or three flat value planes per material, solid clean colors, restrained dark colored outlines, no gradients within characters, no texture noise. Avoid tiny armor seams, buckles, engraved ornaments, fingernails and realistic shading. Give each person two clearly separated feet and a small grounding shadow. At thumbnail size role recognition comes from silhouette and one big equipment cue, not just color. Heads are expressive but minimal, faces one clear light patch with at most a few dark marks. They should feel like individual adventurers with different physiques, not six identical chibis or toys.
SIX SUBJECTS, with fixed positions matching the six old figures:
1. Left middle (old knight): SHIELDBEARER, short very broad calm veteran, low domed steel helmet without plume, blue-gray coat, oversized simple round or rounded-square wooden shield with ONE big notch in its upper rim, partly hides body; short weapon kept understated. His silhouette is wide and grounded.
2. Upper left (old archer): ARCHER, slender alert scout, small rust-ochre hood sweeping backwards, muted teal tunic, one clearly visible long wooden bow held to the outside; forward leaning posture. No blonde ponytail. His silhouette is tall and diagonal.
3. Lower left (old purple mage): ROGUE, compact wary figure leaning sideways, angular dark plum hood and ONE long asymmetrical pale scarf end, one short bright knife held away from body. Visible face patch, no featureless black blob. Silhouette is low with an off-center point.
4. Upper right (old orc): WARRIOR, stocky confident human with short copper-red hair swept into one broad tuft, sleeveless dull brick tunic and one plain shoulder guard, ONE wide gray sword resting diagonally on shoulder. Strong open stance, no shield, no horns.
5. Middle right (old upper goblin): MAGE, thin slightly stooped human traveler with a soft bent slate-blue broad hat, simple cream-and-blue robe, wooden staff topped with ONE large warm amber lantern. Clearly a mage, not a warrior. Tall narrow silhouette with one warm light accent; restrained glow only inside lantern.
6. Lower right (old lower goblin): original small MUSHROOM IMP, waist-high relative to humans, two chunky feet, dull red-brown cap with ONE large chipped edge, pale stalk-body and a grumpy simple face. No spotted cap texture; no copied franchise character.
These are independent original designs; use only the supplied board as reference. No recognizable existing game heroes or enemies. Keep equipment readable and characters modest in scale. Prioritize the user's request: SIMPLE, DISTINCTIVE, CONSISTENT WITH THE TILES.
Variant direction: The balanced baseline. Practical travel clothing and rustic gear. Broad simple shapes and moderate head size, about 2.7 heads tall. Strong clean negative spaces between equipment and body. Warm and understated personalities. Quiet poses with a clear weight shift. Approximately the same amount of visual information in a character as in three adjacent tiles. Stepped pixel edges at roughly the scale visible in the tile seams.

variants.title: Угловатые формы
variants.direction: Make silhouettes strikingly angular, with cut-corner rectangles, wedges and trapezoids. Shieldbearer is a squat block, archer a bent diagonal, rogue a low triangle, warrior an inverted trapezoid, mage a tall crooked column, mushroom a flattened dome. These are still appealing living characters, not geometric icons. Sparse two-tone shading. Dark outlines on shadow sides only, tiled flat planes. Sharper readable personality in the stance.

variants.title: Спокойная палитра
variants.direction: The most terrain-integrated muted colors and flat volume. Reduce saturation to match grass, sand and stone. Character separation relies on strong light/dark masses: bright shield edge, face patches, knife, sword and lantern. Use dark colored contours, never heavy uniform black borders. Slightly elongated bodies, moderate heads, no bobbleheads. Make each distinctive equipment silhouette exceptionally clean. Two or three large value areas only; no texture. A coherent rustic storybook pixel game, with the same raster coarseness as tiles.

variants.title: Характер через позу
variants.direction: Emphasize personality through markedly different asymmetrical resting poses, without adding details: shieldbearer leans patiently on his shield; archer peers ahead under swept hood; rogue crouches sideways with scarf held out; warrior jauntily balances the sword on a shoulder with free hand on hip; mage hunches forward over his lantern; mushroom imp stands defiantly with feet planted wide. Keep all original defining cues recognizable, feet planted, each within a single tile. Clear bold blocky pixel clusters, restrained two-tone shading, little internal linework. Readable expressions from head tilt, not facial detail.

variants.title: Приземистая сказка
variants.direction: The chunkiest and simplest charming interpretation. Short stout bodies about 2.3 heads tall, oversized boots and hands as single color masses, friendly exaggerated body variety. Shields and equipment become bold emblematic shapes with a few stepped pixels, but not smooth icons. Only 2 shades per material, fewer internal edges, use crisp pixelated contours with localized dark outlines to ground them into the tile art. Original unusual folk-adventurer charm, not a franchise parody. Keep bow, sword, lantern, hood and mushroom cap separate unmistakable shapes.
